QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] A Bloodthirsty Schoolgirl
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Bianca, one of the students at the magic academy.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the monsters on the village outskirts and collect #b100#k #banti-magic points#k for Bianca.\r\n#b#eTip#nDouble-click the Anti-magic Charger to check your collected anti-magic points.#k
QuestInfo.2: You gathered anti-magic points for Bianca.

Can proceed to [Kritias] The Clerk

0.0: You look pretty tough. You see the monsters outside the village? When you knock them out, sometimes they drop lumps that look like this: #i2432001#.
0.1: It's called #b#t2432001##k, and it's made of sweet, sweet anti-magic.\r\nAnd it just so happens you can extract anti-magic from them if you have a handy #i2432002##b#t2432002##k.
0.2: Anti-magic's the lifeblood of Kritias. If I got my hands on a good source of the stuff, I could make a weapon that'd blow your socks off.
0.3: So what say you and I make a little business arrangement. You interested in collecting #banti-magic#k from the #bburning#k monsters?

yes.0: Yeah, that's what I thought.\r\nHead over to the #bForest of Laments#k and fight the #bburning#k monsters. When you've got 100 points' worth of Anti-Magic Stones, bring them to me.
yes.1: Double-click on the #b#t2432002##k I gave you, and you'll see how much anti-magic you've got.\r\nBelieve you me, I'd love to be out there beating on monsters myself. But whenever I try to leave town, Dostov sends me right back home!

no.0: That's a shame. A real shame.\r\nI thought you had a future in this town. But if you don't want to combine your brawn with my brains, well... It's your loss.

1.0: That'll do. Now, what kind of weapon shall I make?

yes.0: Here. I want you to have this #b#t2432000##k. You earned it.
yes.1: You want to know about Kritias? What do I look like, a tourist kiosk? I don't have time for history classes.

item.0: You lost the #b#t2432002##k I gave you? Be more careful, butterfingers!

mob.0: All you got to do is defeat the #bburning#k enemies in the Forest of Laments and pick up #b100 points'#k worth of #banti-magic#k. Just don't lose the #b#t2432002##k I gave you, or you won't even be able to collect those points!
